title: Barcelona made easy
text: Convenient  to have for busses and trains and some nice smaller museums.  Easy to retrieve and friendly visitor centre staff.
author: Barry_C

title: Absolutely must!
text:
We recently purchased the Barcelona Card for a four-day trip, and it was an absolutely excellent decision that significantly enhanced our visit.
The card provided incredible value and flexibility. Getting from the airport was seamless, as the card covered the public transportation needed to get into the city center. For the subsequent four days, we took full advantage of the included unlimited public transportation within the city. title: As much as you can handle
text: We did a museum a day and a night out as well so the transportation function really benefited us. But you could easily do 2 museums a day and nights out we just were pacing ourselves.
author: Stephen_K

title: Excellent value for money
text: The Barcelona Card with 72 hours of transport, including trips to the airport, and access to museums was definitely great value for money! It made exploring the city like a local so much easier. The convenience of having unlimited transport access throughout Barcelona was a huge plus, and the museum entries were a fantastic bonus. The only downside was that we couldn’t pick up the card from the airport, as it closes at 8:30 pm and we arrived at 10:45 pm. title: Best bargain
text: Best bargain if you’re traveling to Barcelona.  Savings on museums alone pay you back for your purchase. Easy to travel through Barcelona on the buses. Many of the best museums are either free or at a discounted rate.
author: nicoletM5244PC

title: 5 Days of Museums
text: Well worth the money we paid if you want to visit many Museums. Public transportation is included & it was easy to navigate the area. I’ve purchased City Cards in other countries before.
author: Linda_M

title: Most useful card
text: Most useful transportation card, Barcelona is a city with most advanced transportation networks, with this card you can go anywhere with lowest cost. And save lots money on all kinds of museums.
author: fei_s

title: Barcelona Card
text: The Barcelona Card is well worth buying. It saved us time, and money in the 2 days we had in Barcelona.We only used the transport side in the end, but it made travelling the metro much easier.
author: kathy358

title: For easier travel in Barcelona, get the Barcelona Card.
text:
We used the card for subways and buses, beginning right at the airport into the city. It made our travels throughout the city so easy.
We then continued to take advantage of the card at 4 different museums in our one week stay. We enjoyed being able to just walk in to each and spend as much or as little time as we desired.  
It was well worth the price.
author: Gerald_H

title: Great product, great value
text: What a great product. Do your research well and your Barcelona Card becomes the core to planning your visit.  We went to a museum, to find tickets were sold out for the day, we showed our Barcelona Card and we were allowed in. Getting around on the metro is a breeze. Everyone should get a BC.... Great value.
